blocks.text: The Risk Summary dashboard consolidates top or critical misconfigurations and vulnerabilities from various identity management solutions, such as Active Directory (AD), Entra ID, etc. to provide a broad data-driven overview of risk posture. It also identifies the top endpoint credential exposures contributing to the identity risk posture. The interactive widgets on the dashboard help you to view the entire risk profile of your identity environment, drill down to specific critical risk, and remediate the issue. You can also view issue mappings to security risk frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
The Risk Summary dashboard provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View a snapshot of the risk posture of your entire identity environment.
Quickly prioritize issues with critical severity that are easy to remediate across the identity environment.
Understand the risk composition along with actionable insights and recommendations.
Remediate issues with critical severity and reduce the risk score to improve the risk posture.

blocks.text: On the Risk Summary dashboard (ITDR > Dashboard > Risk Summary), you can do the following:

blocks.item: In the Active Directory widget, select an AD domain from the drop-down menu. You can:
View a unified risk score of the AD domain on a scale of 0 to 100, where 100 is critical.
View a graph that shows the risk score for the AD domain over a period of time.

View the top 3 issues with critical severity that are found in the AD domain. These are issues and misconfigurations that have the highest impact on your risk score and are the easiest to remediate. If you fix these issues first, you can significantly reduce your risk score. Click an issue to go to the AD detailed findings and recommendations page.
Click View All Critical Issues to go to the AD detailed findings and recommendations page to view additional details about all critical issues to further investigate and remediate.
In the Entra ID widget, select an Entra ID tenant from the drop-down menu. You can:
View a unified risk score of the Entra ID tenant on a scale of 0 to 100, where 100 is critical.
View a graph that shows the risk score for the Entra ID tenant over a period of time.

View the top 3 issues with critical severity that are found in the tenant. These are issues and misconfigurations that have the highest impact on your risk score and are the easiest to remediate. If you fix these issues first, you can significantly reduce your risk score. Click an issue to go to the Entra ID detailed findings and recommendations page.
Click View All Critical Issues to go to the Entra ID detailed findings and recommendations page to view additional details about all critical issues to further investigate and remediate.
View the security posture of your endpoints. From the Credential Exposure widget, you can:
View the total number of identities storing endpoint credential exposure issues.
View a graph that shows the total number of credentials exposed on the scanned endpoints scanned over a period of time.

View the top 3 exposed endpoint credentials with critical severity. These are issues and misconfigurations that pose the greatest risk of exploitation and enable lateral movement. Having visibility into these riskiest exposed credentials helps you prioritize what to focus on first and reduce the risk of exploitation. Click an exposure to go to the Endpoint Credential Exposure detailed findings page.
Click View All Critical Issues to go to the Endpoint Credential Exposure detailed findings page to view all exposed credentials to further investigate and remediate.

View all the risks mapped to MITRE ATT&CK exposure techniques and displayed on a kill chain. The MITRE ATT&CK Technique Exposure widget enables you to get visibility into issues that can be exploited by adversaries during various stages of an attack in the event of a compromise. You can hover over the kill chain to view all techniques and issues. Click an issue pertaining to AD, Entra ID, or credential exposure to view additional details about the issue for further investigation and remediation.

Obtain a direct insight into the potential risks associated with your AD domains. Click Go to Active Directory Risk Dashboard to view the Identity Posture dashboard. From the Active Directory Risk At-a-glance widget, you can:
View the total number of AD objects (users and computers) that pose critical risk of exploitation.

View a bubble chart that depicts the distribution of risk types in your AD domains. The size of a bubble represents the proportion of that risk type in your AD domains. The larger the bubble, that particular risk type poses the highest risk in your AD domains. You can click a bubble to view all the issues for that risk type for further investigation and remediation. Click View All Risky Objects to view all the issues categorized by risk type.

View the top 10 users and computers that have the highest risks in the AD domains. Having visibility of these 10 riskiest objects in your AD helps you to prioritize what to focus on first. Click View All Users and Computers to view the details of all AD objects categorized by risk type and severity.

View the details of the recent attacks on the AD objects. Click Investigate All Active Directory Attacks to go to the Investigate page. This page is an interactive and graphical representation of real-time alerts that are the primary indicators of attacker activities.
Obtain a direct insight into the potential risks associated with your Entra ID tenants. Click Go to Entra ID Dashboard to view the Entra ID dashboard. From the Entra Risk At-a-glance widget, you can:
View the total number of Entra ID objects (users, service principals, and configuration settings) that pose critical risk of exploitation.

View a bubble chart that depicts the distribution of risk types in your Entra ID tenants. The size of a bubble represents the proportion of that risk type in your tenant. The larger the bubble, that particular risk type poses the highest risk in your Entra ID tenants. You can click a bubble to view all the issues for that risk type for further investigation and remediation. Click View All Risky Objects to view all the issues categorized by risk type.

View the top 10 identities (users and service principals) that have the highest risks in the Entra ID tenants. Having visibility of these 10 riskiest identities in your tenant helps you to prioritize what to focus on first. Click View All Risky Identities to view the details of all identities categorized by risk type and severity.

View the active changes detected in an Entra ID tenant. The changes are classified as a good, bad, or info impact. Click View All Recent Changes to view the Entra ID Change Detection dashboard. On the dashboard, you can view a detailed report of active changes detected with issue and remediation details.

Obtain a direct insight into the credential risk composition on your endpoints. Click Go to Credential Exposure Dashboard to view the Endpoint Credential Exposure dashboard. From the Credential Exposure Risk At-a-glance widget, you can:
View the total number of identities that have exposed credentials and are critical.

View a spider web chart (radar chart) that depicts the distribution of risk types on your endpoints. The graph shows exposure or scan types having the highest risk score based on the scoring assigned for each exposure or scan type. It also shows the count of identities having critical credential exposure. If the distribution of the risk is towards the edge of the web, the risk is higher for that particular risk type. Click View All Risky Objects to view the credential exposures issues on the Endpoint Credential Exposure detailed findings page.

View the top credential misconfigurations risks in identities that can lead to privilege escalation. Click View All Identities with Credential Exposure to view the details of all the identities that have stored exposed credentials.

View the privilege escalation attack path details for identities storing exposed endpoint credentials. Click View Privilege Escalation Paths to view the privilege escalation attack paths for all the exposed endpoint credentials. You can investigate the vulnerability and remediate the issues.
